Privacy Policy

How AshenWakeAI handles your data.

Data Handling

AshenWakeAI processes data necessary for AI functionality. User conversations are stored temporarily for context. We do not sell personal data.

Discord Data

Discord data is accessed only as necessary for bot functionality and server configuration. Guild IDs and user IDs are used for authorization only.

AI Providers

API interactions with AI providers are mediated through secure connections. Credentials are encrypted and never exposed.

Logs

Audit logs and usage statistics are maintained for operational purposes. IP addresses and timestamps are logged for security auditing.

Cookies & Sessions

Secure sessions are managed using HTTP-only cookies with SameSite attributes. Session data is encrypted.
